summary: Iteration 3: localStorage 'The operation is insecure.' crash fix (frontend only). Playwright with add_init_script making window.localStorage AND sessionStorage getters throw DOMException SecurityError (verified blocked): /login loads with no pageerror/console error and no dev overlay; admin 1234567890/admin123 logs in -> /admin; all 5 admin tabs (vehicles, bookings, dispatch, trips, accounts) load with authenticated data (memory token used); logout -> /login and /admin then redirects to /login. Normal storage regression: token saved in localStorage, reload keeps /admin session, accounts + vehicles tabs load, logout clears token. Extra edge case found: when getItem works but setItem throws (QuotaExceededError, e.g. old Safari private mode / full quota) login 'succeeds' and routes to /admin but every API call is sent WITHOUT Authorization -> 401s, empty dashboard.

integration_issues.flow: Login when localStorage.setItem throws but getItem works
integration_issues.issue: storage.get returns window.localStorage.getItem(k) (null) without falling back to the in-memory value, so the token set in memory is never used -> all /api calls 401 (stats, vehicles, accounts), admin sees empty skeleton dashboard. Fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js: get: (k) => { try { return window.localStorage.getItem(k) ?? memory[k] ?? null; } catch { return memory[k] ?? null; } } (or prefer memory[k] first).

action_items: Minor: in lib/api.js storage.get fall back to memory[k] when localStorage.getItem returns null (handles setItem-only failures like QuotaExceededError)
critical_code_review_comments: storage wrapper only accessed from lib/api.js; no other direct localStorage/sessionStorage usages in src - good.
Primary reported crash (SecurityError on localStorage getter) is fixed: no runtime error, login + navigation + logout work.
Expected limitation: with storage fully blocked, session is lost on reload (memory only) - acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; 1 minor edge-case bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Block storage via page.add_init_script Object.defineProperty(window,'localStorage',{get(){throw new DOMException('The operation is insecure.','SecurityError')}}). Quota edge case: Storage.prototype.setItem = ()=>{throw ...}. Check request Authorization headers via page.on('response').
